description: This file defines the UserMigrationService class responsible for migrating user data from legacy GoogleSync configurations to a new CalendarSync system in SuiteCRM. It handles tasks such as validating system readiness, finding users needing migration, creating OAuth connections, calendar accounts, and disabling legacy sync settings, with detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: UserMigrationService
classes.description: Service class for migrating users from legacy GoogleSync to CalendarSync, handling OAuth, CalendarAccount creation, and cleanup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes dependencies: database, logger, OAuth service.

methods.name: validateUserMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks for necessary modules and database tables, returns list of issues if missing.

methods.name: findAllUsersForMigration
methods.description: Retrieves all users requiring migration, both legacy and new.

methods.name: findLegacyGoogleSyncUsers
methods.description: Finds users with legacy Google Calendar sync configuration.

methods.name: getUserBean
methods.description: Retrieves a user bean by ID, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: extractLegacyUserData
methods.description: Extracts legacy Google sync data from a user, returning a LegacyUserData object or null.

methods.name: findNewGoogleSyncUsers
methods.description: Finds users with existing Google Calendar accounts.

methods.name: migrateUser
methods.description: Performs migration of a user: creating OAuth connection, calendar account, and disabling legacy sync; handles errors and logging.

methods.name: hasNewGoogleCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if user already has a Google Calendar account in the new system.

methods.name: createOAuthConnection
methods.description: Creates and saves an ExternalOAuthConnection for the user, validates tokens, refreshes if needed.

methods.name: validateAndRefreshOAuthConnection
methods.description: Validates OAuth token status and refreshes if expired.

methods.name: createCalendarAccount
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccount record linked to the OAuth connection.

methods.name: disableLegacySync
methods.description: Disables legacy sync preferences for the user.

methods.name: createEmptyUserData
methods.description: Generates empty legacy user data template.

methods.name: createOAuthBean
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate OAuth bean.

methods.name: createCalendarBean
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate CalendarAccount bean.
